scripts.build: npm run build -w quire-plugin-aglc4 && npm run build -w @quire/app
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node scripts/css-lint.mjs && npm test -w @quire/api && npm test -w @quire/app && npm test -w quire-plugin-aglc4 && npm run build && node scripts/offline-audit.mjs
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke -w @quire/app
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/api --noEmit && tsc -p packages/app --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/aglc4 --noEmit
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @quire/app
scripts.shots: npm run build && npm run shots -w @quire/app
